title: Streaming is live again
summary:
A small but useful day: real-time streaming returns, reasoning controls fill out, and IDPhotoGen lands in creative.

Streaming responses now arrive in real time rather than waiting in a buffer. Chat apps can go back to feeling like conversations instead of unusually suspenseful loading screens.

Added the missing reasoning_effort settings: none, minimal, and xhigh. Builders can now select the full range of thinking budgets through the API.

Added IDPhotoGen to the creative ecosystem, giving people another tool for generating practical identity-photo-style images.
